an3.118:4.6: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṃ khitto yena yen' eva patiṭṭhāti suppatiṭṭhitaṃ yeva patiṭṭhāti,
an3.118:4.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave sīlavipatti-hetu vā sattā . . . uppajjanti, cittavipatti-hetu vā . . . diṭṭhivipatti-hetu vā . . . uppajjanti.
an3.118:8.6: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṃ khitto yena yen' eva patiṭṭhāti, suppatiṭṭhitaṃ yeva patiṭṭhāti,
an3.118:8.7: evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave sīlasampadā-hetu vā . . . uppajjanti, cittasampadā-hetu vā . . . uppajjanti, diṭṭhisampadā-hetu vā . . . uppajjanti.
